map.物体质量与速度的乘积。: The product of an object's mass and velocity.
map.动量 p = m × v，m 为质量（kg）、v 为速度（m/s）；动能 Ek: Momentum p = m × v, where m is mass (kg) and v is velocity (m/s); kinetic energy Ek = ½ × m × v²; impulse F × Δt equals the momentum change Δp; doubling the mass doubles the momentum, and doubling the velocity doubles the momentum while making kinetic energy four times larger (for example m = 1000 kg and v = 15 m/s give p = 15000 kg·m/s and Ek = 112500 J).
map.矢量，方向同速度。: A vector, pointing the same way as velocity.
map.碰撞前量：录入两物体质量与速度，求总动量，判断系统合外力是否守恒。: Pre-collision quantities: enter the masses and velocities of two bodies to get the total momentum and judge whether the net external force on the system vanishes.
map.火箭原理：理解喷射质量带走动量、箭体获反冲动量。: Rocket principle: the ejected mass carries away momentum and the body gains an equal recoil momentum.
map.教学演示：演示动量随速度线性变化。: Classroom demo: show that momentum changes linearly with velocity.
map.示例：m=2 kg、v=3 m/s，p=2×3=6 kg·m/s。: Example: m=2 kg, v=3 m/s, p=2×3=6 kg·m/s.
